changes_after_freeze_before_any_forward_: LP-mint signature fetch limited to the forward window (speed; no effect on values).
score now verifies on every run that its engine (run_topups, topup=False) reproduces lphedge2_sim.run and the validated net (+$175.65) exactly; parity confirmed 175.6512 = 175.6512.
with_topups column: added the 30 bp pool swap cost on half of each capital transfer (a balanced withdraw yields half in PUMP that must be sold for USDC collateral).

informational_validation_with_topups.note: Post-hoc (validation already examined), NOT the bar, not used to change the frozen rule. Same rule, but the 1x collateral is restored each 00:00 UTC by moving capital out of/into the LP, so the LP shrinks when the short loses.
informational_validation_with_topups.reading: With honest daily top-ups the validation result would NOT meet the bar. The frozen rule's pass relies on outside capital (about $4.6k) funding the short while the LP keeps compounding its size.

smoke_test: fetch + engine run on 2026-10-04 (inside the examined validation window): 96/96 pool and perp bars, fee consistent with validation after size scaling (ratio 1.85 = LP-value ratio).
expected_50_pool_days: 2026-11-24 is the 50th UTC day from 2026-10-06 if every day is scorable (train and validation had 0 unscored days under this coverage rule); the ledger can reach n=50 when score is run after 2026-11-25T01:00Z.
